definitions.gloss: to liven up, to enliven, to boost
definitions.explanation: To make something more exciting, energetic, or successful through active effort.

definitions.gloss: to support, to back up, to build up
definitions.explanation: To help someone grow or succeed by providing encouragement and support.

examples.english: Everyone worked together to liven up the atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{立|た}てる⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}した→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。
examples.english: We played music to liven up the event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{立|た}てよう⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to cheer in order to support the local team.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{立|た}てる。
examples.english: To support and build up a newcomer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{若|わか}い⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{立|た}てた。
examples.english: The senior members supported and built up the young players.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{立|た}てて、⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{育|そだ}て{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: The people around him supported and built him up until he became president.

notes:
{盛|も}り{立|た}てる means to actively boost, enliven, or support something or someone through effort.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the object being enlivened or supported

ASPECT (ている):
{盛|も}り{立|た}てて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing effort to support or enliven something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{立|た}てる: to liven up the atmosphere
- ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{立|た}てる: to rally/support the team
- ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{立|た}てる: to build up a newcomer
- ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盛|も}り{立|た}てる: to enliven an event

USAGE:
Sense 1 (liven up) focuses on making events or atmospheres more exciting. Sense 2 (support/build up) focuses on helping people grow. Both convey active, collaborative effort rather than passive support.
